authority_rule: These records translate approved dossier reading material into bounded Scryfall discovery threads. They do not replace, strengthen, or rewrite certified identity semantics, and they do not rank cards or commanders.

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes and visible restrictions
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that add costs or explicitly limit attacking or casting.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"cost {1} more" OR o:"can't attack" OR o:"can't cast")

mechanical_threads.label: Permission and counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards whose function is countering a spell before it resolves.

mechanical_threads.label: Timed enforcement
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Addendum wording, board-wide resets, or effects tied to a declared phase.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:addendum OR otag:board-wipe OR o:"during your main phase")

mechanical_threads.label: Hands and hidden information
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that inspect a hand or the top of a library before acting.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"look at target player's hand" OR o:"look at the top")

mechanical_threads.label: Surveil filtering
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards with Surveil that filter the next draw and stock the graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Evasion and selective theft
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find threats that cannot be blocked or effects that take control of another card.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"can't be blocked" OR o:"gain control of target")

mechanical_threads.label: Spectacle and life-loss pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Spectacle cards or effects that care whether an opponent lost life.

mechanical_threads.label: Cards, life, or bodies as a cost
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that ask for life, a discarded card, or a sacrificed permanent as a cost.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"pay life" OR o:discard OR o:"sacrifice a")

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice with a consequence
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice outlets and effects that reward a creature dying.

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into creature pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp that helps a creature-heavy plan claim the board quickly.

mechanical_threads.label: Attacks backed by trample
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures and effects that attack or push damage through with trample.

mechanical_threads.label: Riot momentum
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Riot cards that choose immediate haste or visible growth.

mechanical_threads.label: Convoke community
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Convoke cards that let creatures help cast the next spell.

mechanical_threads.label: Tokens with shared protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token-making alongside effects that protect or strengthen the whole creature board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:token AND (o:indestructible OR o:hexproof OR o:"creatures you control get"))

mechanical_threads.label: Lifegain and anthem preservation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find life gain or team-wide bonuses that preserve a shared board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"gain life" OR o:"creatures you control get")

mechanical_threads.label: Death triggers and obligation engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find death-trigger shells where a creature leaving creates the next payment or benefit.

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes and opponent drain
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that raise costs or make each opponent lose life.

mechanical_threads.label: Afterlife accounts
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Afterlife cards that turn death into Spirit tokens.

mechanical_threads.label: Copy and adjust a spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy an instant or sorcery as the experiment develops.

mechanical_threads.label: Jump-start iteration
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Jump-start cards that recast a known spell by discarding another card.

mechanical_threads.label: Overload breakthrough
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Overload cards that scale a targeted effect across every valid target.

mechanical_threads.label: Trade, then reclaim
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return spent permanents or creatures from the graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Death and graveyard resource loops
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that connect dying or sacrifice to later graveyard value.

mechanical_threads.label: Undergrowth and graveyard counts
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Undergrowth or cards that count creature cards in a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:undergrowth OR o:"creature cards in your graveyard")

mechanical_threads.label: Creature-led ramp and card flow
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures that produce mana or turn creature growth into cards.

mechanical_threads.label: Evolve, Graft, Adapt, and counters
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find biological growth mechanics or +1/+1 counter text.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:evolve OR kw:graft OR kw:adapt OR o:"+1/+1 counter")

mechanical_threads.label: Proliferate and responsive upgrades
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Proliferate or effects that add counters as the board changes.

mechanical_threads.label: Battalion formation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Battalion or effects that reward attacking with a coordinated group.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:battalion OR o:"three or more creatures attack")

mechanical_threads.label: Mentor the front line
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Mentor cards that let an established attacker grow another creature.

mechanical_threads.label: Equipment with protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Equipment or attachment text paired with protection, indestructible, or ward.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:equipment OR o:attach) AND (o:protection OR o:indestructible OR o:ward))

mechanical_threads.label: Cards leaving graveyards
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that explicitly trigger when a card leaves a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"leaves your graveyard" OR o:"leave your graveyard")

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice and recover artifacts
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact cards that connect sacrifice with return or recovery from a graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Attack into a spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find attack triggers that cast, copy, or reveal an instant or sorcery.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:attack AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery) AND (o:cast OR o:copy OR o:reveal))

mechanical_threads.label: Elemental performance
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Elementals that keep the spell's elemental medium present on the board.

mechanical_threads.label: Large spells and copied sequences
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find high-mana-value instants or sorceries and effects that copy them.

mechanical_threads.label: Set up and protect the chosen spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find copying, counterspell, or cannot-be-countered text around a spell plan.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:copy OR otag:counterspell OR o:"can't be countered")

mechanical_threads.label: Pests moving life into value
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Pests connected to life gain, life loss, or sacrifice rather than a generic death mention.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:pest OR o:pest) AND (o:"gain life" OR o:"lose life" OR o:sacrifice))

mechanical_threads.label: Life paid into sacrifice
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that join paying or losing life with sacrificing a permanent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"pay life" OR o:"lose life") AND o:sacrifice)

mechanical_threads.label: Bodies circulating through the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find dying or graveyard text joined to return, tokens, or life gain.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:dies OR o:graveyard) AND (o:return OR o:token OR o:"gain life"))

mechanical_threads.label: Fractals and measured counters
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Fractals or creatures whose size is built with +1/+1 counters.

mechanical_threads.label: Copying and doubling a pattern
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy or double an established object or amount.

mechanical_threads.label: X values and proportional scaling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards whose output uses X, doubles, or scales for each counted object.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"where X is" OR o:twice OR o:"for each")

mechanical_threads.label: Counters and Inklings
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find +1/+1 counter text or Inkling creature and token references.

mechanical_threads.label: Attack incentives
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that reward attacking or point combat toward a chosen opponent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"whenever you attack" OR o:"attacks target opponent")

mechanical_threads.label: Targeted creature or player interaction
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly target a creature, player, or opponent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"target creature" OR o:"target player" OR o:"target opponent")

mechanical_threads.label: Tokens with protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token-making or team protection that helps a wide board survive.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:token OR o:indestructible OR o:"creatures you control get")

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes and rules
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that raise costs or explicitly prevent an action.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"cost {1} more" OR o:"can't attack" OR o:"can't cast")

mechanical_threads.label: Equipment and guardians
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Equipment or equip text that builds and protects a creature.

mechanical_threads.label: Card draw and counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find draw effects or cards whose function is countering a spell.

mechanical_threads.label: Spells that create board pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find instants or sorceries connected to token creation or cast triggers.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:instant OR t:sorcery OR o:"whenever you cast") AND o:token)

mechanical_threads.label: Artifacts and copies
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts or effects that copy a spell or permanent.

mechanical_threads.label: Life payment engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that pay or lose life to draw cards or gain another resource.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"pay life" OR o:"lose life") AND (o:draw OR o:add))

mechanical_threads.label: Aristocrats and sacrifice
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice outlets or effects that reward a creature dying.

mechanical_threads.label: Return creatures from the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return a creature card from a graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Burn and direct damage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards whose Oracle text deals damage.

mechanical_threads.label: Haste and immediate attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Haste cards or effects that reward attacking this turn.

mechanical_threads.label: Impulse draw and Treasures
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find temporary top-card access or Treasure creation.

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp and big mana
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards with a ramp function or land-to-battlefield acceleration.

mechanical_threads.label: Power-four creatures and trample
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find large creatures or creatures with trample.

mechanical_threads.label: Landfall and creature card flow
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Landfall or creature-and-land text connected to drawing cards.

mechanical_threads.label: Exalted and attacks alone
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Exalted or effects that reward one creature attacking alone.

mechanical_threads.label: Creature entries, blink, and Clues
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creature-led entry value, blink text, or Clue creation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (o:enters OR o:clue OR (o:exile AND o:return)))

mechanical_threads.label: Enchantments, Auras, and Equipment
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find enchantment, Aura, or Equipment cards for a supported creature plan.

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells and board resets
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or board-wide removal that narrows the table's options.

mechanical_threads.label: Draw, filtering, and library planning
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find card draw or effects that inspect and arrange the top of a library.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:draw OR o:"look at the top" OR o:"put them back")

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact value engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts connected to drawing cards, counters, or repeatable activation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (o:draw OR o:counter OR o:"activate only"))

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells and creature removal
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or text that destroys a target creature.

mechanical_threads.label: Life, cards, and bodies as leverage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that pay life, discard cards, or sacrifice permanents for another resource.

mechanical_threads.label: Timed damage and life loss
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find damage or opponent-life-loss effects for a decisive finishing window.

mechanical_threads.label: Haste and attack pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Haste or attack-trigger text that forces an immediate answer.

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice and graveyard appetite
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that sacrifice a resource or turn the graveyard into further value.

mechanical_threads.label: Damage from spent resources
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find damage effects connected to a creature dying or a permanent being sacrificed.

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into a creature habitat
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp or land development that supports a creature-heavy board.

mechanical_threads.label: Protection for the bonded board
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find hexproof, indestructible, ward, or protection for creatures.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)

mechanical_threads.label: Large creatures and combat scaling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find power-four creatures or +1/+1 counter text that scales combat.

mechanical_threads.label: A durable creature board
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures or effects that grant indestructible, regeneration, or shield counters.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (o:indestructible OR o:regenerate OR o:"shield counter"))

mechanical_threads.label: Return the dead to duty
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return creatures or permanents from a graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Counters, life, and recursion
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find +1/+1 counters, life gain, or graveyard return that helps a board endure.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"+1/+1 counter" OR o:"gain life" OR (o:return AND o:graveyard))

mechanical_threads.label: Power-four creatures and Ferocious
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find substantial creatures or text that explicitly checks Ferocious or power four.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:ferocious OR o:"power 4 or greater" OR (t:creature AND pow>=4))

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into expensive threats
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp or mana production that supports higher-mana-value threats and abilities.

mechanical_threads.label: Spells and copied effects
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy instants, sorceries, or another spell.

records.intentional_exception: The optional Survival Through Attunement Vox Mana lens remains in the dossier but is not converted into a Scryfall mechanical thread; a card query cannot prove that interpretive lens.

mechanical_threads.label: Mill, discard, or sacrifice as material
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that mill, discard, or sacrifice a resource before converting it into more value.

mechanical_threads.label: Graveyard return and reuse
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return a card or permanent from a graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Tutors, theft, and counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find tutor functions, control-changing effects, or counterspells.

mechanical_threads.label: Raid and attack momentum
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Raid wording or effects that reward attacking this turn.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:raid OR o:"attacked this turn" OR o:"whenever you attack")

mechanical_threads.label: A coordinated attacking formation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that reward multiple creatures or the whole team attacking.

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice, Treasure, and impulse windows
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrificed resources, Treasures, or temporary top-card access that preserves momentum.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:sacrifice OR o:treasure OR o:"exile the top")

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells and protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or protection text that preserves a chosen timing window.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:counterspell OR o:protection OR o:"can't be countered")

mechanical_threads.label: Copy instants and sorceries
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy an instant, sorcery, or spell.

mechanical_threads.label: Prowess and trained attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Prowess or attack triggers tied to noncreature spell play.

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact engines and repeated activation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts that untap, copy, or enable another activation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (o:untap OR o:copy OR o:"activate only"))

mechanical_threads.label: Artifacts recovered from the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts connected to returning or casting from a graveyard.

mechanical_threads.label: Artifacts spent to rebuild
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact sacrifice or artifact-token text that converts one component into the next.

mechanical_threads.label: Cards changing roles in play
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find flexible exile, Treasure, or draw effects that turn the next resource into a new option.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"you may play" OR o:treasure OR otag:draw)

mechanical_threads.label: Storm and copied spells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Storm or effects that copy a spell as the turn changes shape.

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice, damage, and attack openings
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that sacrifice a resource, deal damage, or reward attacking.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:sacrifice OR o:damage OR o:"whenever you attack")

mechanical_threads.label: Attack and damage pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find attack triggers or damage effects that advance the declared front.

mechanical_threads.label: The whole creature line attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that refer to creatures you control and reward attacking.

mechanical_threads.label: Tokens and doubled pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token creation or effects that double a force, amount, or trigger.

mechanical_threads.label: Resources shared with each player
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that give each player cards, lands, mana, or another resource.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"each player" AND (o:draw OR o:land OR o:mana))

mechanical_threads.label: Shared card draw
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly let each player draw.

mechanical_threads.label: Protection around shared value
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find shared-resource text paired with counterspells, protection, or indestructible.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"each player" AND (otag:counterspell OR o:protection OR o:indestructible))

mechanical_threads.label: Counters and proliferate over time
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find +1/+1 counters or Proliferate that grows an investment across turns.

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp and doubling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp or effects that double counters, mana, tokens, or another amount.

mechanical_threads.label: Protect the scaling engine
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find hexproof, indestructible, ward, or protection that keeps a key engine in play.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)

mechanical_threads.label: True colorless mana
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that produce or explicitly require true colorless mana.

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact cards without claiming that every Colorless deck is an artifact deck.

mechanical_threads.label: Eldrazi and Devoid
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Eldrazi cards or cards with Devoid as a separate Colorless direction.

mechanical_threads.label: Five-Color toolbox access
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find tutor functions that help a commander-specific Five-Color plan assemble its chosen answers.

mechanical_threads.label: Five-Color typal reach
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures or payoffs that choose, name, or reward a creature type.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature OR o:"choose a creature type" OR o:"creatures of the chosen type")

mechanical_threads.label: Rainbow and color-count payoffs
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Domain, Converge, Sunburst, all-five-symbol, or color-count wording.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:domain OR o:converge OR o:sunburst OR o:"{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}" OR o:"among colors")

records.intentional_exception: There is no Commander color identity outside Five-Color. The Outside-color stretch lane is replaced by an explicit boundary explanation, and the optional Full-Spectrum Integrator remains dossier interpretation rather than a query claim.
